definitions.explanation: A person who practices calligraphy ({書道|しょどう}) as an art, especially professionally: exhibiting, teaching, or writing titles and signs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{書道家|しょどうか}。
⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{書道家|しょどうか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: We had a calligrapher write the characters on the shop sign.

examples.japanese: {書道家|しょどうか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{両手|りょうて}→両手：09518_ryoute⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧、⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{上|あ}げた→書き上げる：06978_kakiageru⟧。
examples.english: Holding a huge brush in both hands, the calligrapher wrote the characters in one go in front of the audience.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for calligraphers working today, especially those who perform or exhibit. A great calligrapher of the past is usually called {書家|しょか} or {能書家|のうしょか}.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧: calligraphy (the art)
- {書家|しょか}: calligrapher (more traditional and literary)
- ⟦{習字|しゅうじ}→習字：04176_shuuji⟧: penmanship practice, as taught at school
